answer: A concrete sybil defense is staked bonding: every agent locks real collateral to claim a seat, so a swarm of fakes costs as much as one honest node. Picture cheap identities sprawling flat like a mesa, until a staking canyon divides the funded from the frauds. Honest agents moor their bond at a shared escrow wharf; sybils, unwilling to burn capital, never cast off, and their uncollateralized votes carry no weight.
